text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While cooling down with Agnes Digital,
we spotted a crowd of people in front of the school gate...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Those are fans surrounding Falco-san, aren't they~~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Falco-chan, you're soooo cute today too!
Um, um! You're always sparkling... and you're so cool during races, I love you so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I get it... I feel that so deeply,
I want to register Falco-san as a World Heritage site...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Digital-sama, our God!
It speaks right to an otaku's soul... You truly are a God among Gods!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Uh, um, who are you...?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm just a simple Umamusume fangirl!
Sorry for blurting that out, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, so you're a Falco fan!
Were you waiting for her to come out too!?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text: ...No, awake or asleep, Digital-chan is and always will be my absolute number one fave!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Huh!? Me!?
Why, why!? Um... why!?

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text: No matter where I went, Digital-chan was always there—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... A sweet, harmonious cafe date♪
Childhood friends feeding each other is totally unfairrr~~!!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
She gets it...!
She knows the afternoon is a treasure box of pure preciousness!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Praise be, praise be...
Thank you for today's supreme serving of pure preciousness...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text: It's that girl again...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that serious look gazing at her favorite...
And that exquisite distance, never overstepping boundaries."

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text: That girl... she's the real deal...!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text:
I feel respect for Digital-chan as a fellow comrade,
and beyond that, my heart goes *badump* for her!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl
text_block_list.text: I put all of these surging feelings into writing! Please accept it... and with that, farewell!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter practically the thickness of a novel?!
And it even comes with photos of that legendary one-night-only Umamusume unit?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Such dependable comrades are watching over me...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I swear I will channel all the energy from your cheers straight into my favorite Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital was soaring on cloud nine from the gifts sent by her fans!
